title: Thyroid-Stimulating Hormone: An Important Target for the Prevention of Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease.
authors: Wang Z, Wang H, Sun H.
figures: TSH exacerbates hepatic fat accumulation and fibrosis via the SREBP pathway. TSH activates SREBP to regulate the molecular activities of PCSK9, HMGCR, and CYP7A1 through the mTORC or AMPK pathways.
